About these 40 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Saturday has the most, with 12. The earliest start is Silent Sunday at South Mountain at 5:00 am; the latest is Foos Gone Fixed Wednesday Night Ride at 8:30 pm. After work, 11 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 15 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 6. There’s one ride made for LGBTQ+ riders and 3 for women, trans and femme riders. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
